brand.notes: Single letter sheet. The wordmark appears once, in the byline, through the \ac macro with the pink period; the kicker carries the lowercase host name with its own period.

diagrams.notes: A network box over three member laptops in their colours (blush, citrus, indigo), each above an identical box naming the closed AC OS laptop and the plinth; dashed LAN lines from the hub, pink arrows from neo to its siblings for the conductor path; one grey caption line under the centre. Equal widths, shared baselines, visible gutters, centred in the measure.

Three equal boxes in a row (prompt, instrument, window) joined by two-headed pink arrows on a shared centre line; mono heading over a sans role in each; one grey caption line beneath. Centred, with air on both sides.
